gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-spline-san: Loose, hand-drawn charm leads, with Architects Daughter sweeping its s curves wide open at both ends. And Spline Sans, plain sans through and through, gives every horizontal and vertical stroke identical weight, better for brief copy.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noticia-text: Round, stylus-drawn letters take the lead in Bellota. Noticia Text, classic serif with generous entry strokes into every curve, adds a literary counterweight through lowercase bodies that fill most of the letter height.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-epunda-slab: Open, unshaded letters with no pen pressure: that's Bellota Text. Epunda Slab, with tall rounded lowercase and no shortage of dignity, carries paragraph after paragraph in a classic voice.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noticia-text: Bellota Text draws every stroke like a bent steel rod. Against that, Noticia Text brings literary dignity, its big entry strokes and tall lowercase bodies giving the rod-like heading a firm foil.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-recia: Relaxed and inviting, Bpmf Iansui looks squeezed out in one steady line. Recia, classic serif with light modulation you notice mainly up close, carries longer text with sharp authority and generous openings at every weight.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-manrope: Calligraffitti looks traced with a marker, towering midzone and all. Manrope, plain sans with bright open mouths on every curve, holds one pen width, better for brief copy than long text.
gen-gf-eagle-lake-fs-synonym: Loose, hand-drawn letters from Eagle Lake leave clear gaps, with thin joins that slim noticeably yet stay sturdy. Synonym, a dependable sans, sits best at modest sizes, not in long paragraphs.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-epunda-slab: Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, its terminals cut open. Epunda Slab, a serif whose c gapes wide at any size, settles into long paragraphs with classic, dignified ease.
gen-gf-hanalei-fill-fs-paquito: Paquito, a confident serif, keeps its lowercase nearly up to cap height. Hanalei Fill pushes that further, small letters nearly matching its capitals like cut sheet-metal stencils, all drawn without a change in pressure.
gen-gf-iansui-outfit: Iansui writes like a friendly hand, diagonals as sturdy as its uprights. Outfit, sans-serif with open curves and a cable-bent line that never swells, gives the handwriting a straight-laced partner on the page, better for brief copy.
